answer: Rotate the work session key after each job and revoke it the moment the same receipt appears twice. Trust attaches to the task, not to the key, so a cloned account gets a valid key and no history. What breaks first in a farm is replay: two accounts posting one receipt share a key lineage, and the clawback pulls the payment from both. Cost is one live session per task, plus the risk that a single replayed submission burns the whole walnut of saved work. An ember of copied receipts starts it, and one delta between two job logs exposes the pair.
